environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed as AWS Lambda with Function URL. The function URL resource policy contains a StringEquals condition on aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization ID. The Lambda function's execution role trust policy specifies lambda.amazonaws.com as the only trusted service principal. The Function URL is configured with auth-type parameter set to AWS_IAM, meaning the Lambda service evaluates SigV4 signatures on inbound requests before invoking the function. Unsigned requests receive a 403 response from the Lambda service endpoint itself (pre-invocation). The function has no attached resource-based policy granting invoke permission to anonymous principals. CloudTrail logs show InvokeWithResponseStream events only from roles within the organization.
